subs: Every company you've ever heard of started the same way.
你聽過的每一間公司，都是這樣開始的。
Someone stood up in front of a room, and asked them to believe.
有個人站到大家面前，請他們相信自己。
This is ACE Pitch Day.
這就是 ACE Pitch Day。
You built something.
你做出了一個作品。
Now you get three minutes to make the whole room believe in it.
現在，你有三分鐘讓全場相信它。
Everyone gets a sealed envelope of cash.
每個人都會拿到一個封好的信封。
How much? Only you know.
裡面多少錢？只有你知道。
Listen to every pitch.
聽完所有發表，
Then put your money where you believe.
把錢投給你相信的人。
Just one rule.
只有一條規則：
You can't invest in yourself.
不能投給自己。
Whoever raises the most wins one month of Claude Team Premium.
募資最多的人，獨得 Claude Team Premium 一個月。
October fifteenth. Bring your best pitch.
10 月 15 日，帶上你最好的 pitch。
